45 | <#if (depth > 0)><#list 1..depth as i> </#list></#if>${resource.pathLeaf}:
46 | <@write_uri_parameters resource=resource depth=depth+4 />
47 | <@write_resource_parts resource=resource depth=depth+4/>
48 | 
49 | </#macro>
50 | 
51 | 
52 | <#--
53 |   -- write out methods of the RAML resource and then the sub-resources
54 |   -->
55 | <#macro write_resource_parts resource depth>
56 | <#list resource.requestMethodDocs as methodDoc>
57 | <@write_method methodDoc=methodDoc depth=depth/>
58 | 
59 | </#list>
60 | <#list resource.children as child>
61 | <@write_resource resource=child depth=depth/>
62 | 
63 | </#list>
64 | </#macro>
65 | 
66 | 
67 | <#--
68 |   -- write out the method name, description, parameters, body, and response for the given method
69 |   -->
70 | <#macro write_method methodDoc depth>
71 | <#list 1..depth as i> </#list>${methodDoc.requestMethod?lower_case}:
72 | <#if methodDoc.commentText??>
73 | <@write_description methodDoc=methodDoc depth=depth+4/>
74 | </#if>
75 |   
76 | <#if methodDoc.authScopesAsString??>
77 | <@write_auth_scopes methodDoc=methodDoc depth=depth+4/>
78 | </#if>
79 | 
80 | <@write_traits methodDoc=methodDoc depth=depth+4/>
81 | 
82 | <@write_parameters methodDoc=methodDoc depth=depth+4/>
83 | 
84 | <#if methodDoc.requestSchema??>
85 | <@write_body schema=methodDoc.requestSchema example=methodDoc.requestExample depth=depth+4/>
86 | 
87 | </#if>
88 | <@write_response methodDoc=methodDoc depth=depth+4/>
89 | </#macro>
90 | 
91 | <#--
92 |   -- write out method description
93 |   -->
94 | <#macro write_description methodDoc depth>
95 | <#list 1..depth as i> </#list>description: |
96 | ${methodDoc.indentedCommentText(depth+4)}
97 | </#macro>
98 | 
99 | <#--
100 |   -- write out method auth scopes
101 |   -->
102 | <#macro write_auth_scopes methodDoc depth>
103 | <#list 1..depth as i> </#list>securedBy: [ oauth_2_0: { scopes: ${methodDoc.authScopesAsString} } ]
104 | </#macro>
105 | 
106 | <#--
107 |   -- write out method traits
108 |   -->
109 | <#macro write_traits methodDoc depth>
110 | <#list 1..depth as i> </#list>is: ${methodDoc.traitsAsString}
111 | </#macro>
112 | 
113 | <#--
114 |   -- write out all URI parameters for a method
115 |   -->
116 | <#macro write_uri_parameters resource depth>
117 | <#list 1..depth as i> </#list>uriParameters:
118 | <#assign fields=resource.resourceUrlSubstitutions.fields>
119 | <#list fields?keys as key>
120 | <@write_parameter fields=fields key=key depth=depth+4/>
121 | </#list>
122 | </#macro>
123 | 
124 | <#--
125 |   -- write out all query parameters for a method
126 |   -->
127 | <#macro write_parameters methodDoc depth>
128 | <#list 1..depth as i> </#list>queryParameters:
129 | <#assign fields=methodDoc.urlParameters.fields>
130 | <#list fields?keys as key>
131 | <@write_parameter fields=fields key=key depth=depth+4/>
132 | </#list>
133 | </#macro>
134 | 
135 | 
136 | <#--
137 |   -- write out a single query parameter name and type
138 |   -->
139 | <#macro write_parameter fields key depth>
140 | <#list 1..depth as i> </#list>${key}:
141 | <@write_parameter_info field=fields[key] depth=depth+4/>
142 | </#macro>
143 | 
144 | 
145 | <#--
146 |   -- write out a single url parameter type
147 |   -->
148 | <#macro write_parameter_info field depth>
149 | <#list 1..depth as i> </#list>description: |
150 | <#list 1..depth as i> </#list>    ${field.fieldDescription!}
151 | <#if field.fieldType.class.name == "org.versly.rest.wsdoc.impl.JsonPrimitive">
152 | <#list 1..depth as i> </#list>type: <@write_raml_type field.fieldType.typeName/>
153 | <#if field.fieldType.restrictions??><#t>
154 | <#list 1..depth as i> </#list>enum: [ <#list field.fieldType.restrictions as restricton>${restricton}<#if restricton_has_next>, </#if></#list> ]</#if>
155 | <#else>
156 | <#list 1..depth as i> </#list>type: string
157 | </#if>
158 | </#macro>
159 | 
160 | 
161 | <#--
162 |   -- write out request or response body
163 |   -->
164 | <#macro write_body schema example depth>
165 | <#list 1..depth as i> </#list>body:
166 | <@write_body_media_type schema=schema example=example depth=depth+4/>
167 | </#macro>
168 | 
169 | 
170 | <#--
171 |   -- write out media type of request body
172 |   -- (TODO: allow for more interesting media types)
173 |   -->
174 | <#macro write_body_media_type schema example depth>
175 | <#list 1..depth as i> </#list>application/json:
176 | <@write_body_schema schema=schema depth=depth+4/>
177 | <@write_body_example example=example depth=depth+4/>
178 | </#macro>
179 | 
180 | 
181 | <#--
182 |   -- write out all url parameters for a method
183 |   -->
184 | <#macro write_body_schema schema depth>
185 | <#list 1..depth as i> </#list>schema: |
186 | <#list 1..depth as i> </#list>    ${schema?trim}
187 | </#macro>
188 | 
189 | <#macro write_body_example example depth>
190 | <#list 1..depth as i> </#list>example: |
191 | <#list 1..depth as i> </#list>    ${example?trim}
192 | </#macro>
193 | 
194 | <#--
195 |   -- write out response for a method
196 |   -->
197 | <#macro write_response methodDoc depth>
198 | <#list 1..depth as i> </#list>responses:
199 | <@write_response_code methodDoc=methodDoc depth=depth+4/>
200 | </#macro>
201 | 
202 | 
203 | <#--
204 |   -- write out response code for a method
205 |   -->
206 | <#macro write_response_code methodDoc depth>
207 | <#list 1..depth as i> </#list>200:
208 | <#if methodDoc.responseSchema??>
209 | <@write_body schema=methodDoc.responseSchema example=methodDoc.responseExample depth=depth+4/>
210 | </#if>
211 | </#macro>
212 | 
213 | 
214 | <#--
215 |   -- RAML has a limited set of types for URI template parameters
216 |   -->
217 | <#macro write_raml_type type>
218 | <#if type == "float" || type == "double">number
219 | <#elseif type == "integer" || type == "long" || type == "short" || type == "byte" >integer
220 | <#elseif type == "date" || type == "timestamp" || type == "time">date
221 | <#elseif type == "boolean">boolean
222 | <#else>string
223 | </#if>
224 | </#macro>
